verses.text: Oh come, let us sing unto Jehovah; Let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

segments.text: Oh come, let us sing unto Jehovah;
Let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

verses.text: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; Let us make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

segments.text: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving;

verses.text: For Jehovah is a great God, And a great King above all gods.

segments.text: For Jehovah is a great God,

verses.text: In his hand are the deep places of the earth; The heights of the mountains are his also.

segments.text: In his hand are the deep places of the earth;
The heights of the mountains are his also.

verses.text: The sea is his, and he made it; And his hands formed the dry land.

segments.text: The sea is his, and he made it;

verses.text: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before Jehovah our Maker:

segments.text: Oh come, let us worship and bow down;

verses.text: For he is our God, And we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To-day, oh that ye would hear his voice!

verses.text: Harden not your heart, as at Meribah, As in the day of Massah in the wilderness;

segments.text: Harden not your heart, as at Meribah,

verses.text: When your fathers tempted me, Proved me, and saw my work.

verses.text: Forty years long was I grieved with that generation, And said, It is a people that do err in their heart, And they have not known my ways:
